vocabulary.definition: the act of reducing a human being to an object
vocabulary.example: The objectification of women in advertising leads to unrealistic standards of beauty.

vocabulary.definition: someone whose behavior is seen as a good example for others to imitate
vocabulary.example: Many young athletes look up to Serena Williams as a role model for determination and success.

vocabulary.definition: to aim or hope to achieve something
vocabulary.example: She aspires to become a successful entrepreneur in the future.

vocabulary.definition: related to the desire to improve one's life or status
vocabulary.example: The luxury car brand used aspirational advertising to appeal to high-income consumers.
